# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server, 2026-10-21: client-probes/probe_pronecrouch on mp_carentan,
# one --probe-uo-weapon direct client at the net probe's 60 Hz cmds (16, 16 and 18 ms).
# COD_DIR=<install> PORT=34718 SECS=95 tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_pronecrouch mp_carentan
# vcod --net-probe 127.0.0.1:34718 --game-dir <install> --probe-team allies --probe-weapon m1carbine_mp --probe-uo-weapon direct --save-slope --slope-every-state --capture-tag pronecrouch-1.1 --probe-secs 82
# The --save-slope capture cut to the fields the gate reads (!cmd: the cmd as sent; !snap: the
# playerstate the next snapshot carried, ct its commandTime, pm_flags in 1.1's layout), then the
# server's PROBE lines.
